runs.prompt: Why did my wire transfer to Acme Corp fail yesterday, and will I be charged a penalty fee?
runs.answer:
Your wire transfer to Acme Corp for $5,000 on 2026-10-07 did not fail—it is currently held for review. This is because it is the first outgoing wire to this payee and is above the $3,000 threshold. According to the "Payment Screening and Compliance Review" policy, the first outgoing wire to a new payee over $3,000 is held for a standard review, which usually finishes within one business day. A held wire has not failed and is not charged a returned-wire fee.

You will not be charged a penalty fee. For your Premium Checking account, both the $30 outgoing wire fee and the $35 returned wire fee are waived. No fees have been charged for this transaction.

tool_calls.name: find_my_transactions
cypher:
CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes($index, $payee) YIELD node AS cp
MATCH (:Customer {customer_id: $customer_id})-[:HOLDS]->(a:Account)
      -[:HAS_TRANSACTION]->(t:Transaction)-[:PAID_TO|RECEIVED_FROM]->(cp)

WHERE ($type IS NULL OR t.type = $type)
  AND ($date_from IS NULL OR date(t.initiated_at) >= $date_from)
  AND ($date_to IS NULL OR date(t.initiated_at) <= $date_to)

RETURN t.transaction_id AS transaction_id, a.account_id AS account_id,
       a.nickname AS account_nickname, t.type AS type, t.amount AS amount,
       t.currency AS currency, t.status AS status,
       t.initiated_at AS initiated_at, t.posted_at AS posted_at,
       t.available_on AS available_on, t.channel AS channel,
       t.description AS description, cp.name AS counterparty,
       [(who:Customer)-[:INITIATED]->(t) |
         who {.customer_id, .name}][0] AS initiated_by
ORDER BY t.initiated_at DESC
LIMIT $limit

fee_rules.name: Returned wire fee

Rule code: FEE-WIRE-RETURN

When the receiving bank returns an outgoing wire, for example because the beneficiary account number is wrong or the account is closed, we charge a returned-wire fee of $35. The returned funds are credited back to your account.

The returned-wire fee applies only to wires that were sent and then returned. It is not charged for a wire that is held for review or cancelled before it is sent. Premium Checking accounts are not charged the returned-wire fee.

policy_text:
## Large deposits

Rule code: HOLD-CHECK-LARGE

When check deposits on one business day total more than $5,525, we may hold the amount above $5,525 for up to 5 business days. The first $5,525 follows the normal check deposit schedule. We will tell you if a longer hold applies and when the funds will be available.

## Check deposits

Rule code: HOLD-CHECK-NBD

Checks deposited on a business day before the cutoff are available 1 business day after the day of deposit, which is the next business day. For example, a check deposited on a Thursday morning is available on Friday. While the deposit is pending it shows in your account activity, but it is not part of your available balance.

runs.prompt: What's the overdraft fee on our joint account, and how can we avoid it?
runs.answer:
For your joint account ("Standard Checking"), the overdraft fee is $29 for each item that overdraws the account. However, no overdraft fee is charged if your account is overdrawn by $50 or less after the item is paid.

Ways to avoid the overdraft fee, according to the Overdraft Policy:
- Keep track of your available balance, including pending payments.
- Turn on low-balance alerts in online banking.
- Link a savings account you own for Overdraft Protection. If an overdraft occurs, money is automatically transferred from your linked savings account to cover it. Each Overdraft Protection transfer costs $10.
- Make sure deposits are available before large scheduled payments.

Let me know if you want details about setting up Overdraft Protection or have questions about your balances.

checks.fact: no fee when overdrawn by $50 or less

args.question: What is the overdraft fee for Standard Checking, and how can it be avoided?

passages.text:
## What an overdraft is

An overdraft happens when we pay an item, such as a card purchase or an ACH payment, that is larger than your available balance. Your account balance becomes negative until you deposit enough to cover it.

## Overdraft fee

Rule code: FEE-OVERDRAFT

On Standard Checking, we charge an overdraft fee of $29 for each item we pay that overdraws the account. We do not charge an overdraft fee if the account is overdrawn by $50 or less after the item is paid.

rules.condition: Charged per item paid that overdraws the account. No fee when the account is overdrawn by the threshold or less. Waived for Premium Checking.
rules.name: Overdraft fee

passages.text:
## Overdraft Protection

Rule code: FEE-ODP-TRANSFER

Overdraft Protection links a savings account to your checking account. If an item would overdraw your checking account, we automatically transfer money from the linked savings account to cover it, so no overdraft fee is charged. Each Overdraft Protection transfer costs $10. An owner of the checking account must also own the linked savings account. You can set it up in online banking or at a branch.

rules.condition: Charged for each automatic transfer from a linked savings account that covers an overdraft. Waived for Premium Checking.
rules.name: Overdraft Protection transfer fee

passages.text:
# Account Products and Tiers

Effective January 1, 2026. This policy describes the deposit accounts we offer and the main terms of each. Fees are listed in the Fee Schedule. Overdraft terms are in the Overdraft Policy.

## Standard Checking

Standard Checking is our everyday checking account. The monthly maintenance fee is $12. It is waived in any statement period with direct deposits totaling $500 or more. Standard fees apply to wires, overdrafts, and Overdraft Protection transfers. Standard Checking can be opened as an individual or a joint account.

## Premium Checking

Premium Checking is our relationship checking account. The monthly maintenance fee is $25. It is waived when combined deposit balances are $15,000 or more. Premium Checking includes:

- No fee for outgoing or incoming wires.
- No returned-wire fee.
- No overdraft fees and no Overdraft Protection transfer fees.

These benefits apply only to the Premium Checking account itself. They do not extend to other accounts the same customer holds.

## Avoiding overdraft fees

- Keep track of your available balance, including pending payments.
- Turn on low-balance alerts in online banking.
- Link a savings account with Overdraft Protection.
- Make sure deposits are available before large scheduled payments run. See Funds Availability and Check Holds.

## Premium Checking

Premium Checking accounts are not charged overdraft fees or Overdraft Protection transfer fees. This applies only to the Premium Checking account, not to other accounts the customer holds.

## Standard Savings

Standard Savings is an interest-bearing savings account. The monthly maintenance fee is $5. It is waived when the daily balance stays at $300 or more. A Standard Savings account can be linked to a checking account for Overdraft Protection.

## Changing products

You can change from Standard Checking to Premium Checking, or back, at any time in online banking or at a branch. The new terms apply from the next statement period. Fees charged before the change are not refunded.

# Overdraft Policy

Effective January 1, 2026. This policy explains what happens when a payment would take your checking account below zero, and how to avoid overdraft fees.

cypher:
CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes($index, $k, $embedding) YIELD node AS hit, score
UNWIND [hit] + [(hit)-[:NEXT_CHUNK]-(neighbor:Chunk) | neighbor] AS chunk
WITH chunk, max(CASE WHEN chunk = hit THEN score END) AS score,
     max(score) AS rank
MATCH (chunk)-[:FROM_DOCUMENT]->(doc:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rule)-[:FROM_CHUNK]->(chunk)
WITH chunk, score, rank, doc, rule
ORDER BY rule.rule_code
WITH chunk, score, rank, doc, collect(rule {
  .rule_code, .name, .amount, .hold_days, .threshold, .condition,
  .transaction_types,
  kind: head(labels(rule)),
  applies_to: [(rule)-[:APPLIES_TO]->(p:AccountProduct) | p.name],
  waived_for: [(rule)-[:WAIVED_FOR]->(p:AccountProduct) | p.name]
}) AS rules
RETURN doc.title AS policy, doc.policy_id AS policy_id, chunk.text AS text,
       round(score, 4) AS score, rules
ORDER BY rank DESC, chunk.index

runs.prompt: What's the overdraft fee on our joint account, and how can we avoid it?
runs.answer:
For your joint account ("Standard Checking"), the overdraft fee is $29 for each item that overdraws the account. However, no overdraft fee is charged if your account is overdrawn by $50 or less after the item is paid.

Ways to avoid the overdraft fee, according to the Overdraft Policy:
- Keep track of your available balance, including pending payments.
- Turn on low-balance alerts in online banking.
- Link a savings account you own for Overdraft Protection. If you do this, the bank will automatically transfer money from your savings to cover an overdraft, and instead of the $29 overdraft fee, you would pay a $10 Overdraft Protection transfer fee per transfer.
- Make sure deposits are available before large scheduled payments.

Let me know if you want details on setting up Overdraft Protection or have questions about your balances.

checks.fact: no fee when overdrawn by $50 or less

MATCH (c:Customer {customer_id: $customer_id})-[holds:HOLDS]->(a:Account)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:IS_PRODUCT]->(p:AccountProduct)
RETURN a.account_id AS account_id, a.nickname AS nickname, holds.role AS role,
       p.name AS product, p.product_code AS product_code,
       a.ledger_balance AS ledger_balance,
       a.available_balance AS available_balance,
       a.currency AS currency, a.status AS status,
       [(other:Customer)-[:HOLDS]->(a) WHERE other <> c | other.name]
         AS other_holders
ORDER BY account_id

args.question: What is the overdraft fee for Standard Checking, and how can it be avoided?

passages.text:
## What an overdraft is

An overdraft happens when we pay an item, such as a card purchase or an ACH payment, that is larger than your available balance. Your account balance becomes negative until you deposit enough to cover it.

## Overdraft fee

Rule code: FEE-OVERDRAFT

On Standard Checking, we charge an overdraft fee of $29 for each item we pay that overdraws the account. We do not charge an overdraft fee if the account is overdrawn by $50 or less after the item is paid.

rules.condition: Charged per item paid that overdraws the account. No fee when the account is overdrawn by the threshold or less. Waived for Premium Checking.
rules.name: Overdraft fee

passages.text:
## Overdraft Protection

Rule code: FEE-ODP-TRANSFER

Overdraft Protection links a savings account to your checking account. If an item would overdraw your checking account, we automatically transfer money from the linked savings account to cover it, so no overdraft fee is charged. Each Overdraft Protection transfer costs $10. An owner of the checking account must also own the linked savings account. You can set it up in online banking or at a branch.

rules.condition: Charged for each automatic transfer from a linked savings account that covers an overdraft. Waived for Premium Checking.
rules.name: Overdraft Protection transfer fee

passages.text:
# Account Products and Tiers

Effective January 1, 2026. This policy describes the deposit accounts we offer and the main terms of each. Fees are listed in the Fee Schedule. Overdraft terms are in the Overdraft Policy.

## Standard Checking

Standard Checking is our everyday checking account. The monthly maintenance fee is $12. It is waived in any statement period with direct deposits totaling $500 or more. Standard fees apply to wires, overdrafts, and Overdraft Protection transfers. Standard Checking can be opened as an individual or a joint account.

## Premium Checking

Premium Checking is our relationship checking account. The monthly maintenance fee is $25. It is waived when combined deposit balances are $15,000 or more. Premium Checking includes:

- No fee for outgoing or incoming wires.
- No returned-wire fee.
- No overdraft fees and no Overdraft Protection transfer fees.

These benefits apply only to the Premium Checking account itself. They do not extend to other accounts the same customer holds.

## Avoiding overdraft fees

- Keep track of your available balance, including pending payments.
- Turn on low-balance alerts in online banking.
- Link a savings account with Overdraft Protection.
- Make sure deposits are available before large scheduled payments run. See Funds Availability and Check Holds.

## Premium Checking

Premium Checking accounts are not charged overdraft fees or Overdraft Protection transfer fees. This applies only to the Premium Checking account, not to other accounts the customer holds.

## Standard Savings

Standard Savings is an interest-bearing savings account. The monthly maintenance fee is $5. It is waived when the daily balance stays at $300 or more. A Standard Savings account can be linked to a checking account for Overdraft Protection.

## Changing products

You can change from Standard Checking to Premium Checking, or back, at any time in online banking or at a branch. The new terms apply from the next statement period. Fees charged before the change are not refunded.

# Overdraft Policy

Effective January 1, 2026. This policy explains what happens when a payment would take your checking account below zero, and how to avoid overdraft fees.

cypher:
CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes($index, $k, $embedding) YIELD node AS hit, score
UNWIND [hit] + [(hit)-[:NEXT_CHUNK]-(neighbor:Chunk) | neighbor] AS chunk
WITH chunk, max(CASE WHEN chunk = hit THEN score END) AS score,
     max(score) AS rank
MATCH (chunk)-[:FROM_DOCUMENT]->(doc:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (rule)-[:FROM_CHUNK]->(chunk)
WITH chunk, score, rank, doc, rule
ORDER BY rule.rule_code
WITH chunk, score, rank, doc, collect(rule {
  .rule_code, .name, .amount, .hold_days, .threshold, .condition,
  .transaction_types,
  kind: head(labels(rule)),
  applies_to: [(rule)-[:APPLIES_TO]->(p:AccountProduct) | p.name],
  waived_for: [(rule)-[:WAIVED_FOR]->(p:AccountProduct) | p.name]
}) AS rules
RETURN doc.title AS policy, doc.policy_id AS policy_id, chunk.text AS text,
       round(score, 4) AS score, rules
ORDER BY rank DESC, chunk.index
